chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Nadr ibn Shuʿayb, from Khalid ibn Madd, from Muhammad ibn al-Fadl, from al-Thumali, from Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
Allah revealed to His Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله:
So hold fast to that which has been revealed to you; surely you are upon a straight path.
He عليه السلام said: You are upon the wilayah of ʿAli, and ʿAli is the straight path.

key_terms.أَوْحَى: revealed; denotes divine communication from Allah
key_terms.صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ: straight path; the divinely guided way without deviation
key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: ʿAli; Imam ʿAli ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام as identified in the report
key_terms.فَاسْتَمْسِكْ: hold firmly; cling steadfastly to what has been revealed
key_terms.نَبِيِّهِ: His Prophet; the Messenger addressed by the revelation
key_terms.وَلَايَةِ: wilayah; divinely sanctioned authority and guardianship

ai.seo_question: How is the straight path in this verse interpreted in relation to the wilayah of Imam ʿAli عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This narration presents the verse as an affirmation that the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله is firmly upon divinely revealed guidance. It explains that this straight path is the wilayah of ʿAli عليه السلام, identifying him as the embodiment of the straight path in this exegetical context.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Al Nazar Bin Shuayb, from Khalid Bin Madd, from Muhammad Bin Al Fazal, from Al Sumaly, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
[43:43] Therefore attach yourselves to that which has been Revealed to you; surely you are on the Straight Path.
He<sup>asws</sup>: ‘You<sup>saww</sup> upon the Wilayah of Ali<sup>asws</sup>, he<sup>asws</sup> is the Straight Path’.
en.sarwar: 24. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Nadr ibn Shu‘ayb from Khalid ibn Ma’dd from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl from al-Thumali from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following.
“Allah sent revelation to His prophet (s.a) in which He has said, “Follow devotedly that which is revealed to you. You are certainly on the right path.” [43:43]
The Imam (a.s.) said, “It is just as saying, ‘You have acknowledged the Leadership with Divine Authority of Ali (a.s.) and Ali is on the right path.”
